title: Anti AI Vs Anti Slop
author: BomcatTommy
selftext:
I think a lot of the anti AI game development discussion can be solely linked to shitty slop thumbnails. You can make the best game ever, but if it has a thumbnail or banner or any promotional material that looks like obviously AI generated artwork, people will immediately disregard you and your work.

  
I think the gaming industry is going to change, and AI will be used by everyone. It's not going to look like this though.

comments.author: livingFaithGame
comments.body:
"people will immediately disregard you and your work" - this doesn't happen  
most people don't judge products in this way - it's an anti-ai cultist thing

comments.author: Any_Inevitable_4035
comments.body: Because it is more than about creativity and Execution. AI is a tool for game dev not replacement.

comments.author: TheLastTuatara
comments.body:
People don’t like low effort. It’s like seeing stock photos in brochure, or auto tune thrown into a song. 

By now everyone knows what low effort AI looks like and that’s what they are responding to.

If someone can make a better looking Skyrim using all AI- the majority won’t give a shit. That hasn’t happened yet.

comments.author: tryku2
comments.body: It's mostly the frontend/UI & Assets, if you made an an entire game backend & codebase with purely AI without reviewing the code or any manual intervention then no one will be able to tell that the game was made with AI as long as you make your own assets and frontend
